paused_work_physics.scope: Dynamic gravity, collision, friction and settling for transported mats and loose cargo. The carrier follows the continuous playback arc; its weld substitutes for the grasp. This companion simulation does not measure video contact forces or robot-link clearance.

human.method: MuJoCo mjv_updateScene, vertex depth inside oriented solid boxes. Quantiles summarize each frame's deepest vertex. Initial idle samples use the whole body; all frames measure hands, forearms, full arms and the whole body. Separate triangle/box SAT tests cover every skinned triangle including faces crossing a box without an interior vertex; forearm triangles touch at least one dominant forearm vertex.
exclusions: between-frame configurations and intersections shallower than one micrometer in SAT
self-intersection, robot/human intersection during movement, chair, room cabinetry and loose cargo
grip forces and friction, and non-flagship mesh clearance
handover custody checks track controller state and the prop trajectory, not force closure
